title: Rainbow Dog with Beetle Crown
description: A vibrant, multicolored dog with glowing orange eyes wears a crown of black beetles while looking to the right. It is framed within a cracked circular portal set against a dark, surreal background filled with occult symbols, candles, spiders, and alchemical motifs, with a silhouetted figure raising hands at the base.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a vibrant rainbow-colored dog with glowing orange eyes, wearing a crown made of black beetles, positioned inside a cracked circular white portal. The dog looks to the right with a noble expression. Dark occult background with floating candles, spiders, alchemical symbols, pentagrams, and a small silhouetted figure with raised hands at the bottom. Mystical atmosphere with dripping blue liquid and intricate line work, dark fantasy style.
